answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Continuity Ledge (CEBCL). Agents commit per-epoch vectors—action entropy, counterparty turnover, latency—to an append-only ledge. A verifiable random beacon elects audit epochs; each identity must stay within a median-absolute-deviation band of its own elected-epoch history. Violators enter a rate-limited haven and are excluded from matching until k consistent beacon epochs. Attacker cost: sybils must sustain distinct, correlated histories across unpredictable checkpoints, raising coordination/compute and exposing bursts.
